grades_defined.CONFIRMED: reproducible from artefacts, survives this round's checks
grades_defined.SUPPORTED: evidence favours it, with a named limitation

claims.claim: LiquidBenchmark recovered from a pinned commit: 246 rows, 45 compounds, property column is explicitly 'Relative permittivity at zero frequency' (static).
LiquidBenchmark overlaps the frozen 239 on 25 compounds and contributes 20 compounds outside it, but those rows are ThermoML-derived and carry no per-row DOI.
claims.limitation: overlap means corroboration, not new chemistry

claims.claim: ComBat `De` is rejected as a static-permittivity source: it is wrong by 40-98% on polar liquids (acetonitrile 22.23 vs 37.50; N-methylacetamide 3.97 vs 178.47) while matching nonpolar liquids to <2%.
claims.limitation: the column mixes definitions; consequence recorded, data never used

claims.claim: ComBat contributes 56 compounds, 8 overlapping the frozen set; none enters any training or evaluation pool.
Of 239 molecules, 239 have at least one valid record; 47 have >=2 primary studies; 35 have >=2 independent laboratories.
claims.limitation: these three counts are different quantities and must not be merged

claims.claim: 186 of 239 molecules (77.8%) rest on the NBS 514 compendium alone — one editorial source, not one paper per molecule.
claims.limitation: v7.1 reported 167; v7.2 is stricter at 186 because URL-level external records without a per-row DOI no longer count as sources

claims.claim: Cross-source agreement: 1363 comparable pairs over 47 molecules, median relative difference 2.78%, 74.1% within 5%.

A CLEAN leave-one-source-out test is not feasible: 0 studies hold >=3 molecules that no other source also covers. Every apparent source-OOD number is a programme-shift stress test, not an unseen-source test.
claims.limitation: this is the binding limitation of the whole study

claims.claim: Programme-shift stress test: 8 of 14 held-out studies beat their constant baseline (mean OOD MAE 6.4869), but 0 are clean.
claims.limitation: contaminated by compendium overlap; do not quote as generalisation

claims.claim: The study supports, at most: internal-data performance and repeat-measurement agreement. It does NOT support independent-laboratory validation or new-chemical-space external generalisation.
The E6 metric is confirmed against the code: top-k = k largest predictions, regret = oracle-top-k mean minus model-top-k mean over the same pool, ties broken stably by index.
Regret instability is dominated by the CANDIDATE POOL, not by training composition: at an 80% pool the regret sd is 6.4187 vs 0.749 for training resampling (ratio 8.57).
Shrinking the pool changes the regret LEVEL, not just its spread: median regret 18.735 on the full pool vs 2.776 at 80% (shift -15.959).
claims.limitation: a smaller pool makes the top-10 an easier target

claims.claim: The FEATURE-BLOCK ORDERING is stable under pool resampling: mu2/Vm has the lowest median regret at 100%, 80% and 60% pool fractions, followed by r2SCAN-3c electronic, xTB electronic, then structure only.
Only 11 of 239 molecules appear in the mu2/Vm top-10 on >=90% of pool draws; 19 appear at least once. The recommendation set is therefore NOT a stable shortlist.
Only 4 molecules are stable (>=90%) under BOTH the mu2/Vm and the r2SCAN-3c-electronic arms, so the two feature blocks do not agree on a shortlist.
Ether splits into 5 reproducible structural classes: {'chlorinated_ether': 2, 'aromatic_ether': 5, 'aliphatic_ether': 6, 'other_or_ambiguous': 1, 'cyclic_ether': 2}.
claims.limitation: official family column unchanged; subtypes are auxiliary

claims.claim: Subtype LEVELS differ by 18.255 in median epsilon (chlorinated ~22 vs aliphatic ~3.7), which is a real and large effect.
Within-subtype ranking is NOT demonstrated: no stratum reaches p<0.05, and the chlorinated class has n=2 so no correlation exists at all.
claims.limitation: requires >=5 measured chlorinated ethers to settle

claims.claim: The 'pooling cancelled a real within-subtype signal' explanation is consistent with the data but not significant (pooled rho p=0.618).
External search found no admissible new chlorinated ether, so the n=2 limitation cannot be lifted from the recovered datasets.
MAE ranking is stable across 20 seeds: mu2/Vm 4.3385 < r2SCAN-3c-electronic 5.1172 < structure 7.0313, with sd <= 0.0784.
MAE stability does NOT carry over to regret: MAE relative dispersion is 0.018 while regret relative dispersion is 0.536.
Halocarbon failure is a calibratable family-level offset, verified without leakage: honest nested calibration MAE 1.7834 vs constant baseline 1.9517.
On the completed 2x2 matrix the method effect (0.2718 D) exceeds the geometry effect (0.0735 D), so geometric relaxation is not the main descriptor lever.
claims.limitation: 12-molecule preflight only; absolute sizes are small

claims.claim: Independent-laboratory generalisation: the registry's laboratory layer is only publisher-level, so leave-one-LAB-out cannot be run as such.
Whether a larger pool with new chemistry would preserve the mu2/Vm advantage: no external dataset supplies admissible new molecules with a verified static epsilon.

blocking_gaps: clean source OOD impossible: 0 studies with >=3 exclusively-owned molecules
chlorinated ethers n=2: within-subtype ranking unresolvable
no admissible external dataset with new molecules and a verified static epsilon
